name: linkedin
description: LinkedIn REST API v202601 integration: inspect member identity, draft local post previews, upload image assets, and publish posts with strict approval gates.
author: AgentForge

capabilities.description: Verify LinkedIn access token and fetch authenticated member identity via /v2/userinfo

outputs.name: email
outputs.description: Member email address if openid email scope granted

capabilities.description: Format and validate a LinkedIn post (text commentary, optional article URL, optional poll, optional image metadata) and save a preview JSON locally

inputs.name: outputPath
inputs.description: Optional local file path for saving the JSON preview

inputs.name: articleUrl
inputs.description: Optional article URL for link-card attachment

inputs.name: poll
inputs.description: Optional interactive poll ({ question, options, duration })

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: Optional image metadata ({ path, urn, altText })

outputs.name: draftPath
outputs.description: Path where local preview JSON was written

outputs.name: payload
outputs.description: Validated LinkedIn REST posts request body

outputs.name: saved
outputs.description: Whether preview JSON was persisted locally

capabilities.description: Initialize and upload a local PNG/JPG/GIF image asset using LinkedIn Images API (initializeUpload + binary PUT)

inputs.name: filePath
inputs.description: Local path to a PNG, JPG/JPEG, or GIF image file

outputs.name: ownerUrn
outputs.description: Owner URN associated with uploaded asset

outputs.name: httpStatus
outputs.description: HTTP status returned by binary upload

capabilities.description: Publish a text, link-card, poll, or image post to LinkedIn via REST /rest/posts

inputs.name: poll
inputs.description: Optional interactive poll ({ question, options, duration })

outputs.name: published
outputs.description: Whether the post was created on LinkedIn

outputs.name: postUrl
outputs.description: Direct feed URL for the created post

integrations.name: linkedin-access-token
integrations.setupInstructions: Set LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN to an active OAuth 2.0 Bearer token with openid, profile, and w_member_social scopes.

integrations.name: linkedin-person-urn
integrations.setupInstructions: Set LINKEDIN_PERSON_URN to your LinkedIn member URN (e.g., urn:li:person:XXXXXXXX).

auth.name: linkedin-access-token
auth.description: LinkedIn OAuth 2.0 Bearer access token injected at runtime (never stored in manifests or logs)

auth.name: linkedin-person-urn
auth.description: Authenticated LinkedIn member person URN used as author and image upload owner

permissions.approvalReason: Uploads a local image binary to LinkedIn servers via the Images API. Explicit human approval is required.
Publishes a live post to LinkedIn visible to your connections or the public. Explicit human approval is required.

verificationSteps: Export LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN and LINKEDIN_PERSON_URN environment variables
Run profile-me to verify token authenticity and inspect member URN
Run draft-post to validate post commentary/attachments and preview JSON output locally
Approve and run upload-image (if attaching media) followed by publish-post
